title: Budget envelope
idea: Budget envelope: Category balances and recent transactions support one allocation review
audience: People who need to allocate within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: Small household allocations need clear units
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its allocate priority and explicit commitment contract: Totals must reconcile before confirming an allocation
navigation: Budget envelope keeps the current allocate context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Category balances and recent transactions support one allocation review
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to allocate; small household allocations need clear units
composition.priority: Totals must reconcile before confirming an allocation

imagery.role: Support the actual allocate context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use aligned numbers and accessible non-color status
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the budget envelope structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no allocate content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Totals must reconcile before confirming an allocation
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized allocate content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Totals must reconcile before confirming an allocation
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active allocate context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
